events.title: HORROR TRIVIA (Kahoot)!!
events.description:
Philadelphia Area Horror Meetup Group
Join Amanda for some horror-themed trivia using Kahoot!

There will be multiple rounds covering different topics/categories, so everyone can have a chance to play.

Recommend joining on Discord and answering in from cell phone.

This is a new event, so if everyone enjoys it, we can continue in the future!
